# northflank_secret (Data Source)

Reads an existing Northflank project secret group. Useful for consuming secrets managed outside of this Terraform configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_secret" "shared" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  id         = "shared-secrets"
}

output "db_host" {
  value     = data.northflank_secret.shared.variables["DB_HOST"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the secret group (the derived slug of its name).
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project that the secret group belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the secret group.
- `name` (String) Name of the secret group.
- `priority` (Number) Merge priority (0–100).
- `secret_type` (String) Injection scope: `environment`, `arguments`, or `environment-arguments`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the secret group.
- `type` (String) Hierarchy type: `secret` or `config`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Decrypted environment variable key/value pairs.
